key.name: display-duration-ms
key.description: How long a notification stays expanded before collapsing, in milliseconds.

key.name: animation-duration-ms
key.description: Duration of expand/collapse animations, in milliseconds.

key.name: top-offset
key.description: Vertical gap between the screen edge and the island, in pixels.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Accent color used for the progress bar and highlights, as a hex string.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Show incoming notifications as an island pill instead of standard banners.

key.name: media-enabled
key.description: Show a persistent pill with playback controls while media is playing (MPRIS).

key.name: show-seek-bar
key.description: Show a clickable progress/seek bar under media info when expanded.

key.name: enable-badge
key.description: Show a small unread-count indicator next to the clock when notifications are queued.

key.name: enable-pulse
key.description: Subtly pulse the album art / icon while media is playing.

key.name: muted-apps
key.description: Application names whose notifications are queued silently without triggering the island pill.
